text: 不用翻墙，不用翻译，
en: No need to bypass the firewall, no need for translation,

text: 我只是每天阅读两家媒体，差不多知道世界发生了什么，
en: I just read two media outlets every day, and roughly know what is happening in the world,

text: 一家是新加坡《联合早报网》，一家是台湾《中时电子报》。
en: One is Singapore's Lianhe Zaobao Online, and the other is Taiwan's China Times Electronic News.

text: 中时电子报立场偏蓝，所以对于台湾内部报道要带着判断去看，排除那些故意丑化绿营的。
en: China Times Electronic News leans blue, so for its reporting inside Taiwan you should read with judgment and filter out the deliberate smearing of the green camp.

text: 但中时的国际新闻和大陆新闻是可看的。
en: But its international news and mainland news are worth reading.

text: 联合早报和中时电子报对照着看，如果两家都报道的，就几乎是全世界通行的消息，
en: Read Lianhe Zaobao and China Times Electronic News against each other: if both report something, it is almost certainly news accepted around the world,

text: 一家报道一家没报道的，带些自己的判断，找找其他媒体验证下，
en: If one reports it and the other does not, apply some of your own judgment and look for other media to verify,

text: 两家都没报道的，作为值得忽略的垃圾消息，比如日本又发生了什么治安事件。
en: And if neither reports it, treat it as junk news worth ignoring — for example, some public-order incident that happened in Japan.

text: 评论区不少看法，回应几条：
en: Quite a few views in the comments; responding to a few of them:

text: 1.《联合早报网》和《中时电子报》立场都偏左，没错。
en: 1. Both Lianhe Zaobao Online and China Times Electronic News lean left — correct.

text: 否则怎么能做到不翻墙看得到？
en: Otherwise how could you read them without bypassing the firewall?

text: 那些立场偏右的媒体，一样充斥着很多夸大和谣言，关键还是要有独立思考判断力。
en: Those right-leaning media outlets are likewise full of exaggeration and rumours; what matters is having independent thinking and judgment.

text: 2.《联合早报网》在电脑上阅读容易，手机就被屏蔽得厉害，甚至有朋友用微信转发他家新闻被封的。
en: 2. Lianhe Zaobao Online is easy to read on a computer, but heavily blocked on phones; I even have a friend whose WeChat account was banned for forwarding its news.

text: 前些年，联合早报网的内容是选择性放行，比较敏感的消息会偶尔显示不出。
en: A few years ago, Lianhe Zaobao Online's content was selectively allowed through, and more sensitive news would occasionally fail to display.

text: 这两年好了很多，电脑端很少被屏蔽，一方面可能编辑方针有些妥协，但基本新闻坚守还在，还是能做到相对公正，不像凤凰网大公报已经完全是喉舌。
en: These past two years it has improved a lot, and is rarely blocked on computers. On one hand its editorial policy may have compromised somewhat, but its basic journalistic integrity remains, and it can still be relatively fair — unlike Phoenix Net and Ta Kung Pao, which have become complete mouthpieces.

text: 3.路透，CNN原版英文媒体当然可以看，但注意我第一句“不用翻墙，不用翻译”，不用海量看一堆网站，每天天下大事，看看这两家，加上独立思考，基本能和世界同步。
en: 3. Reuters and original English-language media like CNN are of course readable, but note my first line: 'no need to bypass the firewall, no need for translation'. No need to wade through a pile of websites; for the day's big events, reading these two outlets plus independent thinking basically keeps you in sync with the world.

text: 1.拿出三个月的月薪，一个月买证券保险ETF，一个月买半导体ETF，一个月买新能源汽车ETF，涨跌会逼着你看新闻
en: 1. Take three months' salary: one month to buy a securities and insurance ETF, one month a semiconductor ETF, one month a new-energy vehicle ETF. Their rises and falls will force you to follow the news.

text: 2.网络上随便找一个主播，把20世纪历史过一遍，抖音B站一大把，理解当代没有新鲜事
en: 2. Find any streamer online and go through 20th-century history once — Douyin and Bilibili are full of them. You will understand that there is nothing new in the present day.

text: 3.当代中国政治必读县乡中国，充分了解条块是怎么运行的，理解招商引资、房地产和城投公司
en: 3. For contemporary Chinese politics, you must read County and Township China to fully understand how the vertical and horizontal lines operate, and to understand investment promotion, real estate and city investment companies.

text: 4.把一门运动或者艺术练到业余水平，推荐书法 绘画 射箭 DIY模型 插花 烘培这种需要手稳心细的爱好
en: 4. Practise one sport or art to an amateur level. I recommend calligraphy, painting, archery, DIY models, flower arranging or baking — hobbies that require steady hands and a careful mind.

text: 5.有条件可以尝试一下创业，简单摆摊就行，从选品，到供应链价格，再到找位置，营销，后续财务管理，经历这个过程会让人对商业更充满敬畏
en: 5. If you have the chance, try starting a business — even just setting up a street stall will do. From selecting products to supply-chain prices, finding a spot, marketing and later financial management, going through this process will fill you with more reverence for business.

text: 只要不是你亲身经历的，一个字都不要信。
en: Do not believe a single word of anything you have not personally experienced.

text: 比如什么二舅，打眼一看就很可能是假的，因为就一个视频，解说是别人，内容可以随便编。
en: Take the 'second uncle' story, for example: at a glance it is very likely fake, because there is only one video, the narration is by someone else, and the content can be made up at will.

text: 我还说他是越战战斗英雄，身残志坚呢。
en: I could just as well say he was a Vietnam War hero, disabled but indomitable.

text: 我编的一定更精彩，更正能量。
en: What I make up would definitely be more exciting and more uplifting.

text: 所以，只要不是你亲身经历的，一概按假的处理。
en: So, anything you have not personally experienced should be treated as fake across the board.

text: 即便是真的，你按假的处理，对你的效果都一样。
en: Even if it is true, treating it as fake has the same effect on you.

text: 我搭讪过170多个女人，她们的职业有：
en: I have approached more than 170 women, whose professions include:

text: 医生、设计师、老师、护士、编导、运营、销售、模特…
en: Doctors, designers, teachers, nurses, programme directors, operations staff, salespeople, models…

text: 主播、互联网hr、金融、大学在校生、大专在校生…
en: Streamers, internet HR staff, finance workers, university students, college students…

text: 这些女人，本来都不会和我认识。
en: These women would never have met me otherwise.

text: 但当我敢于搭讪的时候，她们的人生，都与我的人生，有了交集。
en: But when I dared to approach them, their lives intersected with mine.

text: 在这个过程中，我得知了我以前从未有过的信息，认识了和我完全不同阶层和圈子的人。
en: In the process, I learned information I had never had before, and met people from completely different classes and circles than my own.

text: 你说我会信息茧房吗？
en: Do you think I would be in an information cocoon?

text: 未来，我还会去搭讪各行各业的男人，尽可能地扩充自己对社会的认知。
en: In the future, I will also approach men from all walks of life, to expand my understanding of society as much as possible.

text: 当年教员写《社会各阶级的分析》，你以为他是拍脑袋，坐在窑洞里空想出来的吗？
en: Back then, when the Teacher wrote 'Analysis of the Classes in Chinese Society', do you think he just made it up, sitting in a cave dwelling dreaming?

text: 不是！
en: No!

text: 是去不断走访调查，得出来的经验汇总。
en: It was a summary of experience gained from constantly visiting and investigating.

text: 信息茧房，本质上是被固化的相似信息和单一的信息源。
en: The information cocoon is, at its core, solidified similar information and a single information source.

text: 只要通过实践，去打破这种信息的相似性，打破单一的信息源。
en: As long as you break this similarity of information through practice, and break the single information source.

text: 那么很容易就念头通达，广博见闻。
en: Then it is easy to have your mind opened and your knowledge broadened.

text: 可惜的是，往往只有少数人，会去为了增广见闻而调查。
en: Unfortunately, only a minority of people will investigate in order to broaden their knowledge.

text: 因为这很痛苦，也很折磨。
en: Because it is painful and tormenting.

text: 要承受被拒绝、掉面子的风险，虽然你那面子不值一文钱，但那是一无所有的你最宝贵的东西。
en: You have to bear the risk of rejection and losing face — although your face is not worth a penny, it is the most precious thing to you who have nothing.

text: 大部分人，只会沉迷在信息茧房营造出来的奶头乐里。
en: Most people will only indulge in the pacifying entertainment created by the information cocoon.

text: 沉浸在今天一个借口、明天一个理由的逃避里。
en: Immersed in today's excuse and tomorrow's justification for escape.

text: 沉浸在键政的幻想、抬杠的愚蠢，还有无价值的追问里。
en: Immersed in the fantasy of keyboard politics, the foolishness of bickering, and valueless questioning.

text: 直面恐惧，直面内心，直面人性。
en: Face fear head-on, face your inner self, face human nature.

text: 那如同凝视深渊，稍有不慎，就会被深渊吞噬。
en: It is like staring into the abyss: a single misstep, and you will be swallowed by the abyss.

text: 营造出信息茧房的最大敌人，不是茧房、资本或者其他什么玩意，而是你自己。
en: The greatest enemy that creates the information cocoon is not the cocoon, capital or anything else — it is yourself.

text: 看书。
en: Read books.

text: 而且要参考评分高的
en: And refer to highly rated ones.

text: 互联网方面，我有点经验。
en: On the internet, I have some experience.

text: 避免信息茧房，可以采用“对冲阅读”
en: To avoid the information cocoon, you can use 'hedged reading'.

text: 记着过去有个咪蒙做的公众号矩阵。
en: I remember there was once a WeChat official-account matrix made by Mimeng.

text: 对冲写作。
en: Hedged writing.

text: 针对不同人群，喂他们不同内容。
en: Feeding different content to different groups of people.

text: 为什么叫“对冲”，是因为有时候人群会分裂为截然对立的两派。
en: It is called 'hedging' because sometimes groups split into two diametrically opposed camps.

text: 主要指意识形态方面。
en: Mainly on the ideological front.

text: 比如粉红vs美分，迷蒙矩阵都有相对应的内容。
en: For example, pink versus US cents — the Mimeng matrix had corresponding content for both.

text: （其实大家立场都差不多。
en: (Actually, everyone's positions are pretty much the same.

text: 路线看法不同很正常。
en: It is normal for views on the line to differ.

text: 自媒体唯恐天下不乱非要在群众里利用媒体搞分裂，煽动极端思想，也挺可恨的。
en: Self-media, fearing the world is not chaotic enough, insist on using the media to create divisions among the masses and incite extreme thinking — that is pretty hateful too.

text: 另外，互联网目前的内容，95%以上是为了迎合碎片化休闲观看、情绪阅读打造的内容。
en: Also, more than 95% of current internet content is made to cater to fragmented leisure viewing and emotional reading.

text: 简单说就是娱乐媒体垃圾。
en: In short, it is entertainment-media garbage.

text: 剩下的，官媒一块，严肃写作一块，都比较小众。
en: The rest — official media on one side, serious writing on the other — is relatively niche.

text: 对冲阅读就是以对冲写作为启发
en: Hedged reading takes its inspiration from hedged writing.

text: 目的是在浩如烟海的垃圾里筛选出有效信息，避免信息茧房，扩大视野，不被别有用心的媒体带跑，尽量抵御陷入乌合之众群体无意识的低智和极端情绪。
en: Its purpose is to filter effective information out of the vast sea of garbage, avoid the information cocoon, broaden your horizons, avoid being led astray by media with ulterior motives, and resist sinking into the low intelligence and extreme emotions of the mindless crowd.

text: 具体做法是：
en: The specific method is:

text: 1 首先找到几个严肃写作的信息源。
en: 1. First, find several serious-writing information sources.

text: 这一点非常难。
en: This is very difficult.

text: 迄今为止我没找到几个。
en: So far I have not found many.

text: 1)一般而言，如果现实里比较严肃的纸质杂志，内容你比较认可，那么这个杂志的对应公众号，是靠谱的。
en: 1) Generally speaking, if you approve of the content of a serious print magazine in real life, then that magazine's corresponding official account is reliable.

text: 现实中纸质杂志已经不多了。
en: There are not many print magazines in real life anymore.

text: 尤其社科，社会新闻相关的。
en: Especially in social science and social news.

text: 为了避免无意义的讨论，我就不列举具体杂志了。
en: To avoid meaningless discussion, I will not list specific magazines.

text: 2)某些学术界有口碑，著书立传作品有口碑的作者学者，开设的媒体专栏公众号等。
en: 2) Authors and scholars with a good reputation in academia, whose books and works have a good reputation, and who run media columns or official accounts.

text: 3）某些严肃写作的官媒，或者官方背景的媒体。
en: 3) Some serious official media, or media with an official background.

text: 官媒主要功能是内宣。
en: The main function of official media is internal propaganda.

text: 但也有少数官方背景的媒体后面的机构，是相对客观做社会调查研究或者做社会新闻的。
en: But there are also a few media with official backgrounds whose institutions are relatively objective in doing social survey research or social news.

text: 也可以参考。
en: These can also be used as references.

text: 4）央媒大号。
en: 4) Major central media accounts.

text: 有必要在思想安全上与中央最新主流价值观保持一致。
en: It is necessary to stay aligned with the central government's latest mainstream values for ideological safety.

text: 5）社科学术研究的号
en: 5) Social science academic research accounts.

text: 6）看个人网红关于社科历史方面的东西，不要太认真。
en: 6) Do not take personal influencers' social science and history content too seriously.

text: 这些人写作目的很明确，基本都是为了流量。
en: These people write with a very clear purpose: basically, to gain traffic.

text: 靠情绪煽动订阅。
en: They rely on emotional incitement to gain subscriptions.

text: 然后卖广告变现。
en: Then they sell advertising to cash in.

text: 不管他是什么站位。
en: No matter what position they take.

text: 都不用太认真。
en: There is no need to take them too seriously.

text: 这类用社科知识包装的情绪写作，本质和迷蒙类似。
en: This kind of emotional writing packaged in social science knowledge is essentially similar to Mimeng.

text: 2 对冲阅读
en: 2. Hedged reading.

text: 看到一个自己认可，信息丰富，深刻的媒体，然后强迫自己去站在对立面，批判性的找到相对立观点的严肃写作的文章。
en: When you see a media outlet you approve of, with rich and profound information, force yourself to take the opposing side and critically find serious-writing articles with opposing views.

text: 不用马上去做这些。
en: There is no need to do this immediately.

text: 所谓独立思考的习惯，也不用刻意去做。
en: The habit of so-called independent thinking does not need to be done deliberately either.

text: 只用时刻记着，有些信息让自己舒服，就有必要去找到让自己不舒服的东西看一看，详细了解别人的思路。
en: You only need to remember at all times: when some information makes you comfortable, it is necessary to find something that makes you uncomfortable to read, and to understand other people's thinking in detail.

text: 当然这些信息源都要从你之前准备筛选好的严肃写作信息源中而来。
en: Of course, these information sources must all come from the serious-writing sources you previously prepared and screened.

text: 3 更接近事物客观规律时的征兆
en: 3. Signs of getting closer to the objective laws of things.

text: 通过对冲阅读，你脑子里现在有两个对照性的观点了。
en: Through hedged reading, you now have two contrasting views in your head.

text: 有时候2个对立观点很矛盾，让人迷糊。
en: Sometimes the two opposing views are very contradictory and confusing.

text: 当你认识到事情没有表面那么简单的时候，往往是一种比过去更接近客观规律的征兆。
en: When you realise that things are not as simple as they appear, that is often a sign of being closer to objective laws than before.

text: 当然，这只是一种征兆，事情总有优劣，人总有优缺。
en: Of course, this is only a sign; things always have pros and cons, and people always have strengths and weaknesses.

text: 得不到简单的结论，确实让人困扰，非常不爽。
en: Not getting a simple conclusion is indeed perplexing and very unpleasant.

text: 这种不爽如果能引发你继续深入思考，或者引起你更全面搜集信息的欲望。
en: If this unpleasantness can prompt you to think more deeply, or spark your desire to gather information more comprehensively.

text: 你承受的不爽，往往值得。
en: The unpleasantness you endure is often worth it.

text: 人就是一种极度复杂的政治动物，由人组成的社会，就更加复杂。
en: Humans are extremely complex political animals, and a society made up of humans is even more complex.

text: 所以唯一而且简单的答案，往往不一定靠谱。
en: So the one and only simple answer is often not necessarily reliable.

text: 但是人脑经过5万年没有任何生理结构的改变，所以5万年前，智人的大脑尽量避免复杂思考，节省能量。
en: But the human brain has undergone no physiological structural change in 50,000 years, so 50,000 years ago, the Homo sapiens brain tried to avoid complex thinking to save energy.

text: 今天我们每个人也是这样。
en: Today, each of us is the same.

text: 我们天生就追求简单、单一的答案。
en: We are born to pursue simple, single answers.

text: 让我们心安，让大脑减少能量消耗，让我们舒服。
en: They reassure us, reduce the brain's energy consumption, and make us comfortable.

text: 你太舒服的时候，往往就是被信息茧房囚困住的征兆。
en: When you are too comfortable, that is often a sign of being imprisoned by the information cocoon.

text: 破解之法就是更全面深刻的信息和对冲阅读
en: The way to break it is more comprehensive and profound information, and hedged reading.
